name: bricks/list-breakpoints
label: List Bricks breakpoints
description: Read the site's responsive breakpoints. Returns `{ baseKey, baseWidth, customEnabled, isMobileFirst, breakpoints, defaults }`, with `breakpoints` sorted by width for the active paradigm. `customEnabled` reflects the `customBreakpoints` master toggle.

customEnabled.description: Whether the site is using custom breakpoints instead of Bricks defaults. Writable through `bricks/set-breakpoints` via `customEnabled`, not through `bricks/set-global-settings`.

isMobileFirst.description: True when the smallest breakpoint is the `base`. CSS is emitted with min-width rules.

baseWidth.description: Width in pixels of the base breakpoint.

breakpoints.description: All breakpoints, sorted by width according to the active paradigm. Each row has { key, label, width, icon, base? }.

defaults.description: The built-in default breakpoints (reference for reset operations).
